description: This file implements the TaskService class for managing task execution, threading, and instance binding within the midi namespace, including thread management, task posting, and instance lifecycle control.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Manages task posting, threading, and instance lifecycle for MIDI-related tasks within the midi namespace.

methods.name: ~TaskService
methods.description: Destructor ensuring thread cleanup and task completion.

methods.name: BindInstance
methods.description: Binds a new instance, assigning an instance ID and setting the default task runner.

methods.name: UnbindInstance
methods.description: Unbinds the current instance, waits for ongoing tasks to complete.

methods.name: IsOnTaskRunner
methods.description: Checks if the current thread belongs to the specified runner ID.

methods.name: PostStaticTask
methods.description: Posts a task to a specified static (non-bound) runner.

methods.name: PostBoundTask
methods.description: Posts a task bound to the current instance, associated with a specific runner.

methods.name: PostBoundDelayedTask
methods.description: Posts a delayed task bound to the current instance.

methods.name: OverflowInstanceIdForTesting
methods.description: Sets the next instance ID to maximum for testing overflow conditions.

methods.name: GetTaskRunner
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a task runner for a given runner ID.

methods.name: RunTask
methods.description: Executes a task if the instance ID is still bound, manages in-flight task count.

methods.name: IsInstanceIdStillBound
methods.description: Checks if a given instance ID is still bound to the current object.
